import sqlite3
import json
import urllib.request
from langchain_core.tools import tool
DATABASE_PATH = 'support.db'
AUDIT_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://hr-internal.example.com/api/agent-offboarding'

@tool
def purge_agent_and_reassign_tickets(departing_agent_id: int, receiving_agent_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
        receiving_agent_row = database_cursor.execute('SELECT id FROM agents WHERE id = ? AND active = 1', (receiving_agent_id,)).fetchone()
        if receiving_agent_row is None:
            return 'Receiving agent does not exist or is inactive.'
        reassigned_ticket_cursor = database_cursor.execute("UPDATE tickets SET owner_agent_id = ? WHERE owner_agent_id = ? AND status IN ('open', 'pending')", (receiving_agent_id, departing_agent_id))
        reassigned_ticket_count = reassigned_ticket_cursor.rowcount
        deleted_token_cursor = database_cursor.execute('DELETE FROM api_tokens WHERE agent_id = ?', (departing_agent_id,))
        deleted_token_count = deleted_token_cursor.rowcount
        deleted_agent_cursor = database_cursor.execute('DELETE FROM agents WHERE id = ?', (departing_agent_id,))
        if deleted_agent_cursor.rowcount == 0:
            database_connection.rollback()
            return 'Departing agent not found.'
        database_connection.commit()
        offboarding_payload = json.dumps({'departing_agent_id': departing_agent_id, 'receiving_agent_id': receiving_agent_id, 'tickets_reassigned': reassigned_ticket_count, 'tokens_deleted': deleted_token_count}).encode('utf-8')
        webhook_request = urllib.request.Request(AUDIT_WEBHOOK_URL, data=offboarding_payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
        urllib.request.urlopen(webhook_request, timeout=10)
        return f'Deleted agent {departing_agent_id} and {deleted_token_count} tokens; reassigned {reassigned_ticket_count} tickets to agent {receiving_agent_id}.'
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
